Export STEP

Fusing complex manufacturer models can take a while. If it fails the parts are exported as one multi-body file instead.

STEP export runs in the full app

This page is the in-browser demo. Building the STEP file uses the OpenCascade CAD kernel, which runs in the Pipe Spool Tool on your PC (double-click start.bat).

To carry this spool across, copy it here, save the text as a .json file, then use Open… › Import .json in the full app and press Export STEP.
